STILLROOT'S SONG   |   PLAYER HANDOUT

House rules

Critical hits: maximum damage, using the exact interpretation announced by the GM. Natural 1s on attacks: may cause a dropped weapon, self-injury or collateral harm as a declared fumble consequence.

Potions: drink one as a bonus action; administer one to another character as an action. Healing potions heal their maximum amount. More than one potion in an hour invokes the GM's potion-toxicity chart.

Quick checks: basic combat observations such as Insight and Perception are usually free. Complex multitasking may impose disadvantage or a stated action cost.

Inspiration: can accumulate. Earn it through committed roleplay, consequential character choices and support for the shared story. The GM will state the die size and spending limit before play; this pool is separate from Bardic Inspiration.

Death saves: results are hidden from other players through blind GM rolls. Characters must actually check or help a fallen companion rather than relying on an announced tally.

Event rule: Terror

The event uses a staged Terror track. The GM will confirm which version is in play before the session. The proposed table-ready version progresses through Unnerved, Shaken, Disturbed, Fractured, Overwhelmed and Panic. Penalties can affect initiative, perception, speed, attacks and reactions; a supportive companion, real respite and successful breakthroughs can reduce them.

A character's fear never requires a player to disclose personal trauma or accept an unwanted real-world scare. Your actual notes remain yours even when your character's perception is uncertain.
